For 2/d, first branches yield T=2 at d≡1 mod4 or d≡3 mod12; elsewhere numerator 3→4→5 with B=d(d+3)/2, C=B(B+4)/3≡7 mod8, finishing at fourth step iff B≡0 or1 mod5. CRT gives {7,35,47,55} mod60; maximal proper divisors 30,20,12 fail as periods. Hence relative densities 2/3,2/15 and <=4 total 4/5. Independent bounded recurrence implementation agrees; no infinite stopping claim.
